ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed @ 100.47) and overbought (daily RSI 74). A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 10 · daily cycle day 10).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 74). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
